title: Beautiful experience
text: Authentic flamenco show. An experience to live to fully immerse yourself in Andalusian culture. We are not particularly fans of dance under normal circumstances, but we were captivated by the emotion that emanates from each of the artists and the power of the show. I recommend it!
author: 563mathildep

title: Impressive
text: A great experience. The artists were very professional, the dancer was hats off. 100% recommended.
author: SilviaGlezQ

title: A first rate taste of Flamenco.
text: An authentic and intense cultural experience. Not to be missed. It’s in a small back street room very close to the city centre. Get there a bit early to get front row seats.
author: markbF3392IO

title: Wonderful show!
text: I recommend this show. Excellent artists. Very good atmosphere. Also, the staff is very friendly.
author: jacquesliliana

title: Great experience
text: Simply wow! Great atmosphere, aesthetics, super room, and proximity to the artists. The evening was great and will be remembered for a long time!
author: leonid1986

title: Mesmerising performance
text: Incredible performance of music & flamenco. Utterly spellbinding!!!
author: Mary J

title: Mesmerising!
text: Just wow! A small theatre so very close to the performers. Started with guitar solo then joined by singer and percussionist on a wooden box then the flamenco dancer who was incredible! Complete drama over 3-4 dances, I was totally drawn into the performance… it was stunning! Performance lasted just over an hour. Nice venue with a bar
author: tmid

title: Excellent flamenco show
text: We greatly enjoyed this flamenco show. The musicians and dancer were masterful and they poured an extraordinary amount of emotion into their performance.

title: Fabulous show
text: What an amazing oerformance, it was the best flamenco show we have seen, so mesmerising .  Very intimate venue full of authentic feel. Dancers , singer, guitarist and percussionist were fantastic. Footwork  by the dancers was unforgettable. What a fabulous show, you won’t be disappointed
